findings: A complete saved pow test file does not establish a precision bound over all binary64 input pairs.

The existing exact_boundary decomposition addresses the rational exact/midpoint cases. Its powers-of-two, repeated exact square roots and54-bit odd significand checks match the relevant boundary criteria; a dedicated implementation proof remains separate.

Unbounded Ziv refinement with a complete boundary test is a route to mathematical termination. Current fixed arrays, a1024-bit ln2 slice,16-bit series divisors and the MCU memory budget prevent simply removing the final trap.

sources.finding: The project describes pow hard cases as concentrated on exponents allowing exact or midpoint results; the corpus is not a whole-domain precision proof.
For binary64 and multivariate functions the project checks known hard cases rather than exhaustive inputs.
Lauter and Lefevre give efficient rounding-boundary detection for adaptive evaluation. Exact boundaries must be separated from cases settled by growing precision.
